# Local continuation under author checks

23 October 2026. The user explicitly removed the outstanding review prerequisites and instructed continued implementation of the full master plan. Independent AI, specialist, engineering, practitioner, learner and screen-reader reviews are optional follow-up, not gates on local authoring, validation, acceptance or integration preparation. This supersedes earlier local review-gate requirements. No rejected external review operation is retried.

Local acceptance records use `authorVerification.kind: author-check` and bind the current revision, content and rendered-code digest to actual author checks. They do not create independent review receipts. Existing receipts remain unchanged as historical evidence. Physical and participant sessions remain unperformed; professional reviewer fields remain empty. The renderer labels author-checked previews distinctly. Legacy independent-review acceptance is retained for archived records and rejects stale receipts as before.

The six existing pilot texts and activities remain intact. The four already archived pilots receive new revisions for the changed runtime and acceptance basis; earlier revisions remain available through explicit note export. Craft/performance retain their original revision because neither had an archived edition. No private note store is read or migrated by these changes. Craft remains a structural model without a physical specimen; performance remains a generated digital stimulus with its existing local asset terms. The new law and health pilots supply original bounded learning tasks, not professional approval or a decision about a reader's health or legal dispute. Source access, truthful claims, privacy, actual rights and automatic validation remain substantive requirements.

## Source checks

The four named CRA sections (9, 19, 20, 22) returned HTTP 200 from their official URLs on 23 October. The web reader could not parse XHTML; an ordinary direct request to the same URLs succeeded. All four byte hashes match the retained 22 October preparation captures. Their displayed editorial cutoffs still differ (22/20/22/21 October) and future/outstanding notices remain. No certified current-law consolidation is claimed. The statutory timing paragraphs and their exceptions were inspected; the activity only applies the ordinary arithmetic to stipulated facts. Repair waiting periods return no ordinary deadline.

NHLBI's [breathing description](https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/lungs/breathing-benefits) was reread on 23 October, including the diaphragm phases and the distinction between air movement and gas exchange. Its third-party animation is excluded. No stopped clinical or licence source was reopened.

## Verification

The source/schema/model suite passed 100 test groups. The native-browser suite passed 27 groups; three affected layout/activity groups passed again after making long numeric tables horizontally scrollable. A saved-state normalization inconsistency (`0.50` versus `0.5`) was repaired. Desktop and phone, light and dark, static reading, keyboard controls, notes, sharing, malformed windows and impossible irrigation requests were exercised. This is author verification, not human learning or screen-reader observation.

Eight pilots and six follow-ups are now authored and checked locally: diplomatic perspectives, archaeology premises, Frankenstein editions, Cabuliwallah narrative access, Cicero disclosure and the water ledger. Selected historical quotations retain their exact prepared text and hashes; the archaeology truth table matches all eight prepared cases, and water tests verify conservation, delivery limits, missing values, corrections and path differences.

For subsequent authoring, run `node scripts/check-local-continuation.mjs` for read-only schema, source-binding and model/source tests. After actually inspecting new source/content changes, run `node scripts/check-local-continuation.mjs --record --date YYYY-MM-DD` with the real check date to record author verification and rebuild the workshop/orientations. Then run the affected browser and integration tests. This command does not supply specialist qualifications, source freshness, real sessions or public release. Before freezing a changed already-retained lesson, increment its revision and preserve `previousRevisions`; immutable earlier editions must not be replaced.

Supplemental source identities bind exact preparation-packet bytes and the original source URL/read record. Earlier source registers, quotes, access stops and review evidence remain untouched. New orientation verification covers the changed local lesson links and rendering; all 30 substantive orientation texts and their historical reviews remain retained.
